node.title: PMA sigma-one defect-three background payment
node.statement: On every official sigma=1 maximal sunflower, the complete source class with defect d=3 and the unique background point retained has size at most C(k-1,3) floor(C(n-k,3)/4)<n^6/9216. Together with the d<=2 payment, all cells d<=2 or (d,r)=(3,1) are below n^6/8192 per sunflower. The first unpaid finite source cell is (d,r)=(3,0), followed by higher defects; the later first-layout domination theorem removes the finite chart multiplier.
